source_evidence: Player exact 'Well luckily it was us and not some other poor traveler. Might as well make sure no one else gets extorted or hurt. Mara, stay back with the merchant. Cirren, Fenar, and I will walk up. I tell them we are all going to pass through, if they have a problem go ahead and do something about it.' V rejects prior partial-deterrence counteroffer and no further Knack is requested. Mara willingly moves behind to merchant; companions accompany V. The captain's existing independent extortion motive and failed DC19 withdrawal justify initiating hostilities rather than another free intimidation check. Captain gives order, initiative immediately before attack; no surprise, no free hostile attack or full approach movement. Initial limited dismount/steps are normal prehostile dialogue movement. Fix combat positions and group initiative, verified original MM statblocks from approved mirror blob. Genuine visible Python secrets batch a4f64e842c6e411395bb368ac795b247, faces V17,Fenar16,Cirren19, Captain18,Veteran19,Thugs3,Scouts4; modifiers V5 (Dex4+Luckstone1),Fenar2,Cirren2,C3,Vt1,Thugs0,Scouts2, order V22,Cirren21,C21,Vt20,Fenar18,Scouts6,Thugs3. Declared tie rule allies first. No new resource or attack. G1 independent bandits not connected to hidden operation; G2 confrontation chosen, retreat/negotiation still available; G3 verified 2014 roster and action economy, geometry, morale, initiative, no waves or arbitrary reinforcement. D321~10:31 Ossent frontier road, combat begins R1 V initiative22 first, all actions/bonus/reactions/movement available. Player orders Mara to stay back with merchant; she willingly retreats to wool wagon at(-45,-5) with cover where obstructed, merchant remains by wagon bench near(-35,0); both avoid engagement and protect teams, no independent attacks or initiative required unless they enter combat. Own coach center(0,0), horse team x10–20 along road; merchant wagon center(-40,0), horses x-30–-20, all healthy. V/Cirren/Fenar step out and begin walking forward; V gives exact ultimatum. Captain refuses to abandon robbery and orders archers to shoot advancing defenders; no attack before initiative, no surprise, no additional movement after hostilities start. Combat start positions V(5,-5,0), Cirren(5,5,0), Fenar(5,-10,0) after safely dismounting coach roof. Road west positive x, width20ft y±10, east retreat open, brush and broken walls by scouts provide half cover when line obstructed; coach/wagon solid body obstructs appropriate lines. C Bandit Captain(60,0) AC15 HP65, Vt Veteran(65,5) AC17 HP58, T1(55,8)/T2(55,-8) Thugs AC11 HP32 each, S1(40,25)/S2(40,-25)/S3(70,25) Scouts AC13 HP16 each; all speed30, no hidden foes. All have visible weapons, no action/reaction spent, gang wants plunder and is willing to fight but not suicidal; retreats if leader disabled or majority down as credible circumstances permit, no forced surrender. 2014 MM profiles verified via 5etools blob ea2a16def25116746411fa1de80c346444228759. Initiative genuine group rolls: V17+5=22, Cirren19+2=21, C18+3=21 (Cirren first by declared tie rule), Vt19+1=20, Fenar16+2=18, scouts4+2=6, thugs3+0=3. No attacks/damage/resource consumption yet. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots equipped; no concentration. Mara/merchant/horses healthy. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, rations9/feed12 before D321 full-day charge, LR0/6; random encounter count2/5 consecutive2, no D321 night roll and D322 mandatory quiet. No unrelated quest/knowledge/custody changes. V dice delegated until stop. Await V's Round 1 turn.
